$description: The widget registry of specs v48.0.0 to v101.3.3 (contracts/layouts.md § The widget registry, § Spans and rows, § Widget actions, § The governance page, § The dashboard, § The universe frame; universes/widgets.feature, dashboard-layout.feature), as data for the backend, the shared library of the layout derivation, the theme studio and both apps. Per widget: its theme surfaces (since design v4.0.0, specs v99.0.0: the four families page, sky, block and control; every widget on block, its controls on control), its widget variants (and the canvases a variant is limited to), its parameters (values and default), its live content, the universes it is offered in (public, private, root: the root universe), the universes where it is required, whether it may be stowed in a widget rail, and whether it may be contextual. scripts/check-documents.mjs checks that schemas/layout-v1.schema.json names the same widgets and checks the layouts against it. A widget may carry "since", the registryVersion it joined in (1 when absent): lib/layout applyRegistry completes the layouts served for an older version, except with a widget whose "completion" is false. Since registryVersion 3: "railOnly", the variants of a widget placed in a widget rail only (the head row as a live button); "pinnedRail", a widget that may not be stowed but may be a live button in a pinned rail of a phone canvas (the time column); "behaviors", the behaviors its live button takes when not all; "onUniversePage": "button", a widget placed on the page of a universe as a live button only (the open votes, LAYOUT_WIDGET_NOT_ON_PAGE otherwise). Since design v2.9.0, the free blocks (textBlock, imageBlock, linkBlock, channelBlock, buttonBlock, separatorBlock, spaceBlock: the widgets marked freeBlock since design v4.0.0) and the navigation widget of registryVersion 2 (the pages of a universe, the document break-rocks-layout/3) are carried here too, "completion": false; lib/layout checks and derives the pages of a universe (checkPageCanvases), registry/page-icons.json lists the icons of the custom pages. Since design v4.2.0 (specs v99.0.0, D-293): "ignored", a widget no layout places any more (the live line, merged into the time strip the apps draw): a placement is accepted and ignored; the action turn is withdrawn.
fullOnlySpan: A widget whose variants are full (and hidden) only covers any number of columns of its canvas, from 1 to all (the rules post, the head row, the layout switcher over 8 or 4 columns in the platform layouts and in the example of the contract); the spans above hold for the widgets with variants.

fullScreen.what: the feed over the whole canvas, under one band with the name of the universe, the time strip (the live line until specs v99.0.0), the live button of the time column (a public universe; not in hud on a phone since specs v79.0.0, where the time column is the now page) and the way to post; the same action, or a double tap anywhere on the feed, brings the canvas back

expand.what: the widget in wide in place of its live button, until closed
expand.where: a live button on the canvas

open.what: the widget in a one-off view over the page: a sheet from the bottom on a phone, a side panel on a tablet and a desktop

switch.what: the focus of the feed, or another layout on the device

stow.what: the widget as a live button in its rail (a reader retouch)

variant.what: another variant allowed at its place (a reader retouch)

step.what: since specs v79.0.0: the next or the previous tile of the time strip (the live line until specs v99.0.0), in its order; the action of its sideways scroll
step.where: the time strip, drawn by the apps (no widget a gesture names)

turn.what: withdrawn since specs v99.0.0 (D-293): the time strip never turns by itself; from specs v79.0.0 to v99.0.0, the live line turned every 6 s in its order, or stopped turning; a gesture turn of a document published before stays readable (on the live line, ignored) and is refused on a widget placed

gestures.doubleTap: fullScreen by default on the feed, in every layout
gestures.longPress: never on the feed (the long press of a post)

feed.name: feed

filter.note: a PostsFilter; the others than ALL where offered (living-universes.md § The feed filters)

feed.note: never a live button; shows the focus the reader is in; covers at least half of the columns of a tablet or desktop canvas

clips.name: clips
clips.liveContent: a mark when a clip was posted in the universe after the last reading of its clips on the device (Universe.lastClipAt)

timeColumn.name: time column

chart.note: for the votes cast against the quorum and the collective goal of level

timeColumn.liveContent: the card that comes first, with its time left; nothing under way: says so, and opens the time column with what the reader may start
timeColumn.note: full is a band on a phone; on a phone canvas it may be a live button, on the canvas or, since specs v69.0.0, in a pinned rail (the now page), never in a folded rail

liveLine.name: live line
liveLine.note: since specs v99.0.0 (D-293): merged into the time strip, which the apps draw at the head of the content column of every universe page, never placed by a layout; kept for the documents already published: a placement is accepted and ignored (not drawn, not checked, not counted in the widget budget, left out of the derived canvases), LAYOUT_LIVE_LINE_REQUIRED no longer raised; until then on block, variants full, wide and medium, required everywhere

whoGoverns.name: Who governs

style.note: gallery: the governance gallery, drawn by the platform layout governance (since specs v69.0.0)

whoGoverns.liveContent: the number of the questions to the leadership waiting for an answer (none below the village, and in a private universe); its icon the avatar of the president, or of the members of the college (since specs v69.0.0)
whoGoverns.note: a private universe: for the owner and the admins

agenda.name: agenda
agenda.liveContent: the next universe event, with the time before it starts
agenda.contextual: a universe event starting within 24 hours or under way

projects.name: projects
projects.liveContent: the number of projects in progress
projects.note: a sub-universe: those of its first level

debates.name: debates
debates.liveContent: the number of open debates and open polls

channels.name: channels
channels.liveContent: the number of channels with a message the reader has not read; in a public universe, the number of the messages of its public channels of the last 10 minutes (UniverseNews.channelMessages), never their live readers
channels.contextual: since specs v79.0.0: a channel with a news badge (UniverseNews.channelMessages > 0)
channels.note: for the members of a private universe; in a public universe from the governance level village, for every reader (specs v70.0.0, D-189: a rule of the reader's app, which reads the governance level of the universe), widget and live button alike

view.note: map where the sub-universe map is offered

map.name: map

events.note: the universe events of the next 90 days with a place or a zone

subUniverses.note: the direct sub-universes, each placed by its universe events of the next 90 days with a place or a zone (since specs v49.8.0)

locatableResidents.note: the locatable residents, for a resident; all four false: LAYOUT_PARAM_INVALID (the widget would show nothing)

map.liveContent: the number of universe events of the next 90 days with a place or a zone

universeBanner.name: universe banner
universeBanner.note: it alone draws the image slot pageHeader

rulesPost.name: rules post

folded.note: true: a line that unfolds; false: in full

rulesPost.note: comes before the feed in the reading order

headRow.name: head row
headRow.liveContent: the pinned announcements and pinned posts that arrived since the last visit (UniverseNews.pinned)
headRow.contextual: since specs v79.0.0: a news badge (UniverseNews.pinned > 0); a contextual live button may then be placed on the canvas
headRow.note: button since specs v69.0.0: the announcements, in a widget rail, OPEN; on the canvas its variant full covers any width

openVotes.name: open votes
openVotes.liveContent: the open votes the reader can vote on and has not voted on (UniverseNews.votesToCast), as an action, else the number of the open votes (TimeColumn.openVotes, the second round counted)
openVotes.note: since specs v49.9.0, on the governance page (required there, each vote as a timeColumnCard in its vote state); since specs v69.0.0, on the page of a universe as a live button only (LAYOUT_WIDGET_NOT_ON_PAGE otherwise); never added to a layout published before

proposals.name: proposals
proposals.liveContent: the number of the proposals WAITING_SUPPORT
proposals.note: since specs v49.9.0; required on the governance page

myDuties.name: My duties
myDuties.liveContent: the number of the appeals the reader is drawn as juror for, waiting for their answer or their juror vote (myJuryDuties)
myDuties.note: since specs v49.9.0; for a resident only (hidden, its live button included, for anyone else)

rules.name: rules and texts
rules.note: since specs v49.9.0; every universe but the root universe; required on the governance page

pinnedChannels.name: pinned channels
pinnedChannels.liveContent: the number of the pinned channels with a message the reader has not read (Channel.unread, joined channels only)
pinnedChannels.note: since specs v49.9.0; offered in every universe but the root universe (public universes since v2.8.0), required on the private universe governance page

members.name: members
members.liveContent: the new residents of the last 7 days (UniverseNews.newResidents), never the residents online; opens the members page
members.note: since specs v69.0.0 (D-188): a live button only; drawn hidden for a reader to whom toHandle is shown (the layout places both); never added to a layout published before

toHandle.name: to handle
toHandle.liveContent: what waits for the reader's action (UniverseNews.toHandle): for a member of the leadership, the questions to the leadership waiting for an answer; for a moderator, the posts reported to the moderators waiting for their decision; opens them in a one-off view
toHandle.contextual: since specs v79.0.0: what waits for the reader (UniverseNews.toHandle > 0)
toHandle.note: since specs v69.0.0 (D-188): a live button only, for a member of the leadership or a moderator (hidden, its live button included, for anyone else); never added to a layout published before

textBlock.name: text block
textBlock.note: since specs v49.10.0: a free block, placed on a custom page and among the free blocks of the about page (since specs v50.0.0) only (LAYOUT_WIDGET_NOT_ON_PAGE elsewhere); an id and a content of its own (contracts/layouts.md § The free blocks); never added to a layout published before

imageBlock.name: image block
imageBlock.note: since specs v49.10.0: a free block, placed on a custom page and among the free blocks of the about page (since specs v50.0.0) only (LAYOUT_WIDGET_NOT_ON_PAGE elsewhere); an id and a content of its own (contracts/layouts.md § The free blocks); never added to a layout published before

linkBlock.note: since specs v49.10.0: a free block, placed on a custom page and among the free blocks of the about page (since specs v50.0.0) only (LAYOUT_WIDGET_NOT_ON_PAGE elsewhere); an id and a content of its own (contracts/layouts.md § The free blocks); never added to a layout published before

channelBlock.name: channel block
channelBlock.note: since specs v49.10.0: a free block, placed on a custom page and among the free blocks of the about page (since specs v50.0.0) only (LAYOUT_WIDGET_NOT_ON_PAGE elsewhere); an id and a content of its own (contracts/layouts.md § The free blocks); never added to a layout published before; in a public universe, one of its public channels (since specs v50.1.0)

buttonBlock.name: button block
buttonBlock.note: since specs v49.10.0: a free block, placed on a custom page and among the free blocks of the about page (since specs v50.0.0) only (LAYOUT_WIDGET_NOT_ON_PAGE elsewhere); an id and a content of its own (contracts/layouts.md § The free blocks); never added to a layout published before

separatorBlock.name: separator block
separatorBlock.note: since specs v49.10.0: a free block, placed on a custom page and among the free blocks of the about page (since specs v50.0.0) only (LAYOUT_WIDGET_NOT_ON_PAGE elsewhere); an id and a content of its own (contracts/layouts.md § The free blocks); never added to a layout published before

spaceBlock.name: space block
spaceBlock.note: since specs v49.10.0: a free block, placed on a custom page and among the free blocks of the about page (since specs v50.0.0) only (LAYOUT_WIDGET_NOT_ON_PAGE elsewhere); an id and a content of its own (contracts/layouts.md § The free blocks); never added to a layout published before

navigation.name: navigation
navigation.note: since specs v49.10.0 (contracts/layouts.md § The navigation widget): the menu of the pages of a universe; at most one main menu placed (NAVIGATION_MAIN_DUPLICATE); bottomBar on a phone canvas only (NAVIGATION_FORMAT_INVALID); a secondary menu names its pages in params.pages (1 to 20), a menu in a widget rail its rail in params.railId (LAYOUT_RAIL_INVALID): two parameters checked by checkPageCanvases, not by the values above; never added to a layout published before (the apps add it)
